title: List my Mods
description: Easy list of your mods for copy-pasting elsewhere: when reporting issues; sharing your mod list, etc.
body:
Provides an easy and accessible way to view all of your installed mods. This is useful in a variety of scenarios; for example, sharing your mods, viewing the homepages to your mods, and providing a list for stack traces.

There are four different ways to view your mod list.

1. /listmymods

![/listmymods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7d5b9ccd70f8991e6a41c94efbd38350cc2d19a_0.webp)

Simply lists all of your mods in chat, so you can view them.

_You can click on the links that appear._

2. /listmymods file

![/listmymods file](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16f18e48e485a5fcfbc28992fad109626f187269.png)

Sends your mod list to a .txt file located in ~/.minecraft/mymodlist-my-mods.txt. The command will automatically open the file in your associated application (VSCode, notepad, etc).

3. /listmymods md file

![/listmymods md file](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/824bcbc25b9b1860c7ce4b95fcc25402105ba241.png)

_raw markdown_

![/listmymods md preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a3c2c04fb6113529417e9718f904d49384bd534.png)

_A preview of how it will look. The links are clickable._

Sends your mod list to a .md file located in ~/.minecraft/mymodlist-my-mods.md for use on GitHub or other apps that support markdown formatting.The command will automatically open the file in your associated application (VSCode, notepad, etc).

4. /listmymods extensive

![/listmymods extensive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a85281e907a36fd1bbafcc3f5d5250a53b8c6c3a_0.webp)

Provides a more thorough list including versions, the mods ids, and their authors. 

**But what about Mod Menu?**
Mod Menu is great for configuring and viewing _your_ mods, but you can't export your list or share them with others - which is the point of this mod.
